description: External interrupts INT0 to INT5 and one pin-change interrupt of each group (PCINT0 to PCINT2) of the Mega 2560.
basis: ATmega2560 datasheet 15 (external and pin change interrupts) and attachInterrupt of arduino:avr@1.8.8: INT0 to INT3 on pins 21, 20, 19, 18, INT4 and INT5 on pins 2 and 3, mode FALLING counts the falling edges (1, 2, 1, 1, 3, 1); a pin change interrupt fires on every edge of an enabled pin: pin 10 (PCINT4) 2, pin 15 (PCINT9, PJ0) 4 for two pulses, pin 62 (PCINT16) 2
